does: Resolves the roll of a cast for one initial target in the cast's targeting state: reads the cast's spell modifications and casting state (ModificationContainerComponent, IsCastingComponent) and the InitialTarget (sixth argument), and evaluates the spell roll on the target through code:unplaced::EvaluateSpellRollOnTarget; also called for every attack of a goblin's weapon spell.

evidence.says: its typed arguments are a WorldView of eoc::spell::ModificationContainerComponent and eoc::spell_cast::IsCastingComponent and an InitialTarget; it calls 0x37268D0
one call per Sacred Flame cast, from +0x37CF5D9; the chains of Sacred Flame, Hold Person and a goblin's weapon attack pass it at +0x37D0718

questions.ask: the InitialTarget's layout (which offset holds the target entity) - read it from a watch of the sixth argument during a Fire Bolt cast
